quotations.old_english: Hlehterlic hit ys wanhálnysse tóbrocenre ealles líchaman wunda feáwa geswutelian
quotations.latin: ridiculum est debilitate fracta totius corporis uulnera pauca monstrare

source_text: hleahtor-lic. Dele the passage given, for which see leahtor-lic, and add; -- Hlehterlic hit ys wanh&a-long;lnysse t&o-long;brocenre ealles l&i-long;chaman wunda feáwa geswutelian ridiculum est debilitate fracta totius corporis uulnera pauca monstrare, Scint. 38, 7.
